brief:
The Trump administration notified Congress of plans to send more than $206 million for a proposed Gaza peacekeeping force, marking the first substantial funding for a stalled U.S. plan to rebuild Gaza, Al-Monitor reported. The commitment comes as diplomatic efforts continue over the structure and terms of any international presence in the territory.

The funding represents a significant step toward implementing the administration's vision for post-conflict Gaza, though details on the force's composition, mandate, and operational timeline remain unclear. The proposal has faced obstacles as various parties negotiate over governance and security arrangements.

title: US commits $206 million to proposed Gaza peacekeeping force
